displayName.text: Musashino Mori Coffee Far Eastern Garden City Shop

text.text: Wonderful staffs. They knew what they are doing and try to accommodate you. The food was OK. Maybe I had higher expectation. But it was just fine. Can't complain but personally didn't really impressed me. My only complain is that there is time limit of 2 hours.

text.text: It’s the worst service ever!! We came in at 10:28am. Then the staff told us the breakfast can be ordered. After we sat down, we didn’t have the breakfast menu. The staff came and asked us to order with the breakfast menu. How could we choose the food in a few seconds. Then i refused to order the breakfast instead I wanted to order lunch menu, so I didn’t have to wait. The staff told me I had to wait for the lunch menu can be served and ordered. What the hell?? Also, we waited almost 40 mins for the food to come. When the pancakes arrived, it wasn’t completely cooked. It’s a super bad restaurant and will never come back again!!

text.text: A clean coffee shop with a bright aesthetic, modern decor, and plenty of seating. Service was fast and efficient and we didn't need to wait long to be served, or have our order ready. The French toast gets a thumbs up! Situated very close to the Cultural Park and the nearby some, so easy to access. We were a big group, and there was no problem seating us (your mileage may vary depending on the day of the week!)

text.text:
Food is acceptable. Stake is chewy but taste is fine; soup size is exquisite; pasta and pizza are good.

However, the waiting time is unbelievably long. Never ask them to serve desserts after meal. You will get another round of long wait more than 30min.

The food was good but i find their souffle pancakes bordering raw. Its very wet inside and has an eggy taste.

Service was friendly and the ambiance is very nice.
